description: Server-side data fetching and processing logic for app installation onboarding, including user, team, app metadata, and event type management.

methods.name: mapEventType
methods.description: Maps database event type object to frontend TEventType with URL and booking fields.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Fetches user info along with admin teams and their logos.

methods.name: getOrgSubTeams
methods.description: Retrieves sub-teams of an organization, including logo URL handling.

methods.name: getAppBySlug
methods.description: Fetches app details by slug if enabled.

methods.name: getTeamEventTypes
methods.description: Retrieves event types for given teams, with optional filtering for conferencing.

methods.name: getUserEventTypes
methods.description: Retrieves event types for a user, with optional filtering for conferencing.

methods.name: getEventTypes
methods.description: Determines whether to fetch team or user event types based on input.

methods.name: getAppInstallsBySlug
methods.description: Fetches app credentials for user and teams.

methods.name: handleAutoInstall
methods.description: Creates default installation credential or returns existing if conflict occurs.

methods.name: getEventTypeGroupsForStep
methods.description: Gets event type groups for onboarding step, including destination calendar assignment.

methods.name: getInitialStep
methods.description: Determines initial onboarding step and possible redirect based on context.

methods.name: getAppAndMetadata
methods.description: Fetches app info and metadata, with redirect if not found.

methods.name: getCredentialId
methods.description: Selects credential ID based on team or user.

methods.name: prepareUserTeams
methods.description: Prepares list of user teams, including sub-teams if organization.

methods.name: getCredential
methods.description: Determines credential ID, auto-installs if needed, and handles redirects.

methods.name: getTeamsInstalled
methods.description: Returns list of user teams with installation status.

methods.name: getInstallationParams
methods.description: Extracts and parses installation parameters from request context.

methods.name: getServerSideProps
methods.description: Main server-side function orchestrating onboarding data fetching, validation, and redirect logic.
